subject: Monkey D. Luffy
continuity: One Piece before the time skip
content: Monkey D. Luffy is the captain of the Straw Hat Pirates in One Piece. Before the time skip his rubber body lets him stretch limbs for punches, sweeping attacks and defensive inflation. Gear Second accelerates his combat and taxes his body. He protects his crew and tends to commit directly to a fight. This test material excludes later awakening powers and does not establish any game mechanics or balance values.
intent: Capture elastic reach and the decision to build up tension before a burst. Keep the gameplay readable.

subject: Shikamaru Nara
content: Shikamaru Nara is a shinobi in Naruto known for tactical planning and shadow techniques. Shadow possession restrains another person through connected shadows. It takes concentration and chakra and is sensitive to positioning. He often wins through preparation rather than brute strength. This supplied test material describes the early-series character and excludes later abilities.
intent: An unusual control unit whose positioning and limited resource create a choice about when to hold targets. Avoid a generic projectile tower with shadow names.

subject: Alphonse Elric
content: Alphonse Elric is a kind, protective alchemist in Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood. His soul is bound to a large suit of armor. He uses martial arts and alchemy and often protects companions. His armored body does not need ordinary food or sleep, but the binding of his soul is a vulnerability. This supplied test material does not imply that he has magical healing or a shield ability.
intent: Express protection with supported positioning or control. Explain the cost of protecting others; do not invent healing, shields or runtime transformation.
